fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: White paint looks clean overall but slightly flat, without strong gloss, on the hood and side panels in daylight shots
Black lower body cladding and fender flares look slightly gray and faded along the rocker panels and wheel arches
Tires look dry and unshined in all exterior shots
Headlight lenses look mostly clear in the front shots; no obvious yellowing visible
No interior photos beyond glimpses through the windows, so interior condition can't be judged; a finger also covers part of the front bumper in one shot
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Grand Cherokee, and the white paint looks to be in nice shape. The black cladding along the rockers and wheel arches looks a little faded, and a wax and trim restoration would make it pop in photos. We do mobile pre-sale details that come to you. Would you like a quote?
